status: ROUND 2. Registered after round-1 results were seen and BEFORE the candidate below was run. criteria.json is unchanged and its S1-S7 apply to this candidate verbatim at both frame rates; round-1 results are preserved in results/experiment-round1.json and results/verdict-round1.json.
honest_labelling: This candidate was designed from round-1 failures (A leaked during warm-up and after absences; B lost real boxes to its proof delay) on the same footage. A pass is evidence that the design is consistent with all registered criteria, NOT blind generalization: no untouched footage exists. Its parameters were fixed by the argument below, not searched.

H_spot_memory_and_motion_proof.idea: drop a box iff BOTH (1) its spot has held a raw box in at least `share_threshold` of the trailing window's processed frames (A's test) AND (2) its track has not yet moved `proof_distance_px` from where it started (B's test). A ball passing through an occupied spot has a proven track and is kept; a static false box never proves anything. Tracks and spot memory both see RAW boxes, so suppression never unlearns.
H_spot_memory_and_motion_proof.why: B's parameters and the radius are unchanged. Proven tracks are never dropped whatever the occupancy, so the occupancy test no longer has to stay above the busiest genuine spot (3.3%); 3% is chosen just under it so that only a spot busier than any genuine rim spot on a development clip counts, over a window twice as long (the round-1 leak came from forgetting after an absence) and a history of 3 s (the leak came from a 5 s warm-up).

sensitivity_only_not_eligible.purpose: show how much the result depends on the one threshold. They are reported next to H and cannot be recommended in its place.

decision_rule: as criteria.json. If H fails any criterion at either frame rate, nothing is recommended for integration and the failure is reported.
